name: What factors influence the cost of door and hardware installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of door and hardware installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of door and hardware installation is influenced by several factors: the type and material of the door (e.g., solid wood, fiberglass, steel), the complexity of the hardware (e.g., smart locks, multi-point locking systems), whether a new frame is needed, and any structural modifications required. For accurate pricing, we provide a detailed estimate after assessing your specific needs and the existing conditions of the installation site.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation costs depend on door material, hardware complexity, frame requirements, and structural modifications. A detailed estimate is provided after assessing your specific project.
